Getting Started

Starting from where you are

These questions help beginners, career changers, graduates, and people new to the UK market understand whether Anderseed is a good fit.

Do I need IT experience to join Anderseed Consulting?
No. The mentorship is built for beginners, career changers, graduates, and people entering the UK job market with transferable experience.
Who is the Business Analysis mentorship for?
It is for people who want a structured route into Business Analysis, including career changers, graduates, people returning to work, newcomers to the UK market, and professionals who need CV, LinkedIn, interview, and job-search support.
Can I join if I work full time?
Yes. The programme is designed for busy learners, including people who work full time. You will still need to make time for live sessions, practice, and job-readiness work.
Can I start with the free BA roadmap first?
Yes. The free BA Career Roadmap is designed for people who want clarity before joining the premium mentorship or booking paid support.
Programme & Training

How the mentorship works

The programme is designed to combine live learning, practical Business Analysis work, and accountability.

What is included in the 8-week Business Analysis mentorship?
The bundle includes live mentorship, practical Business Analysis training, real project practice, CV and LinkedIn support, interview preparation, recruiter and hiring contact guidance, community access, and post-role support.
Is this a Business Analyst course or a mentorship programme?
It is a mentorship programme with training, guided practice, accountability, and career support. The focus is not just learning theory, but building confidence, project language, documentation skills, and job-readiness.
Will I work on real Business Analysis project practice?
Yes. The programme includes hands-on project-style practice so learners can work through requirements, stakeholder scenarios, process mapping, documentation, and practical Business Analysis thinking.
What Business Analysis skills will I learn?
You will learn Business Analysis fundamentals, requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, process mapping, documentation, software development lifecycle awareness, CV positioning, LinkedIn positioning, applications, and interview preparation.
How long does it take to become Business Analyst-ready?
The live cohort runs for 8 weeks, with a 90-day journey designed to help learners build practical skills, confidence, and job-ready positioning.
How much time should I set aside each week?
Most learners should plan for live sessions, practical tasks, CV or LinkedIn work, and application preparation each week. The exact time depends on your current experience and how quickly you want to move.
Career Support

CV, LinkedIn, applications, and interviews

Anderseed supports both the learning journey and the job-readiness work needed to speak confidently to recruiters and hiring managers.

Is the programme focused on the UK Business Analyst job market?
Yes. The positioning, CV guidance, LinkedIn review, job application support, salary context, and recruiter guidance are focused on Business Analysis roles in the UK market.
Do you help with CV and LinkedIn?
Yes. The mentorship includes ATS-proof CV and LinkedIn framework support, expert reviews, and guidance on how to present transferable experience in Business Analysis language.
Do you help with job applications and interviews?
Yes. Learners receive a job application playbook, interview preparation, mock interview support, and guidance on how to explain Business Analysis value clearly.
Do you give access to recruiters or hiring contacts?
The premium bundle includes access to BA recruiter and hiring contact guidance. Learners are still responsible for applying, networking, and following up professionally.
What support do I get after the cohort?
Learners receive ongoing support through the alumni community, career check-ins, job-search encouragement, and 6 months of support once they are in the role.
Roadmap & Community

Free support before premium mentorship

The free roadmap and Telegram community are designed to help people build clarity before deciding on premium support.

What is the free Telegram community for?
The free Telegram community gives prospective learners access to Business Analysis tips, job-search guidance, support, live session updates, and cohort announcements.
What happens after I download the free roadmap?
You can use the roadmap to understand the path, join the free community, read practical blog content, or apply for premium mentorship when ready.
Can I stay connected if I am not ready to pay yet?
Yes. You can download the roadmap, join the free community, read the blog, and follow Anderseed social channels until the premium mentorship feels like the right next step.
Payments

Pricing and payment options

Payment options are designed to make the checkout step clear, with flexible routes where available.

Can I buy individual services without joining the full programme?
Yes. Individual services such as CV writing, CV review, job application guidance, interview preparation, and LinkedIn review can be purchased separately where available.
Can I pay in instalments?
Yes. Payment options include card payment, Klarna Pay in 3 where available, and bank transfer. Payment details are shown during the checkout process.
How does bank transfer work?
Choose bank transfer on the checkout page to view the payment details. Use your full name and BA Mentorship as the payment reference so your payment can be matched correctly.
Job Outcomes

Honest expectations

The goal is to improve readiness, positioning, and confidence while staying realistic about hiring outcomes.

Is there a job guarantee?
No. Anderseed Consulting does not guarantee jobs, interviews, or salary outcomes. The programme focuses on practical skills, positioning, confidence, feedback, and support.
What salary can Business Analysts expect in the UK?
Salary ranges vary by industry, experience, location, and hiring market. The website gives an indicative UK Business Analysis salary snapshot only.
Does Anderseed apply to jobs for me?
No. The programme gives guidance, resources, positioning support, and job-search strategy, but learners are responsible for applying, networking, preparing, and attending interviews.
Terms & Privacy

Trust and compliance

Legal and privacy information is kept on dedicated pages so it is easy to find and update.

Where can I read the terms and privacy notice?
The detailed legal and trust information lives on dedicated pages: Terms and Privacy Notice.
Will my details be sold to third parties?
No. Your details should be handled in line with the privacy notice and are not sold to third parties.
